name: Musical Dream Note
source:
This is the story of a girl that wants to fight and achieve her dream with her friends; four girls that are going to go their musical journey. Anne Notedream is a girl with a slight fear of music. When she enters high school, she meets three girls that are interested in music composition. Anne wants to fight her fear and overcome it. She joins their music composition club to fight and make their dream come true...
